landingPage.heroTitle: Start, operate, and grow your business
landingPage.heroSubtitle: Find out what your business needs to get started, explore funding programs, and learn about the requirements that apply to you.

cards.title: Choose a business structure
cards.text: Compare the most common business structures and see how each one affects your taxes and personal liability.

cards.title: Find funding programs
cards.text: Grants, loans, and tax credits are available for businesses at different stages.

cards.title: Understand your requirements
cards.text: Learn which registrations, permits, and filings may apply to your type of business.

cards.title: Learn about taxes
cards.text: Find out which taxes your business may be responsible for and how to file them.
